question: Find the simple interest on ₹1,35,000 at 6 (3)/(4)% per annum for 6 years.
solution:
Given:

Principal = Rs. 1,35,000

Time = 6 years

Rate of interest = 6(3/4)% per annum

Formula used:

S.I = PRT/100

Where, P = Principal

R = Rate of interest

T = Time period

Calculation:

S.I = Rs. (135000 × 27/4 × 6)/100

⇒ 675 × 27 × 3

⇒ ₹54,675

∴ The required simple interest is **₹54,675**

8a
